import sys

def calculate_days_off(n):
    full_weeks = n // 7
    extra_days = n % 7

    min_days_off = full_weeks * 2
    max_days_off = full_weeks * 2

    if extra_days > 0:
        max_days_off += min(extra_days, 2)
    
    return min_days_off, max_days_off

print(min_days_off)
print(max_days_off)
